channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: ‘Maximum level of accountability’ needed after Mandelson arrest – Labour MP
item.description: We spoke to Labour MP Bell Ribeiro-Addy following the arrest of Lord Mandelson.

item.title: Mexico: President tries to calm fears after troops and cartel clash
item.description: Trepidation hung over Mexico on Monday as relative calm seemed to be holding after 24 hours of violence.

item.title: Cartel violence ‘not a good advert’ ahead of World Cup – journalist
item.description: We were joined by journalist Ioan Grillo in Mexico City.

item.title: Government overhauls special education with £4bn plan
item.description: The number of children with special educational needs is rising rapidly in England, and the government says SEND, the system to help them, is broken and unable to cope.

item.title: How the government’s SEND changes are being received by families
item.description: Our reporter Ruben Reuter has been looking at the government's plans and joined us earlier to discuss them.

item.title: Education secretary: ‘no one will be losing support’ with SEND changes
item.description: We spoke to Education Secretary Bridget Phillipson and began by asking her whether the billions announced today for SEND will be enough.

item.title: Nottingham Inquiry begins examining what led to fatal attacks
item.description: A public inquiry has begun into the events leading up to the Nottingham knife attacks.

item.title: Uganda’s defiant opposition leader speaks out from hiding
item.description: It's been more than a month since Uganda's presidential election triggered a new crackdown on the opposition.

item.title: BBC apologises after not editing out racial slur heard during BAFTAs
item.description: The BBC is under fire for not editing out a racial slur shouted by a man with Tourette's syndrome from its broadcast of last night's Baftas.

item.title: Story of Malawian boy who saved flooded village hits stage
item.description: A Malawian boy who saved his village from floods and drought by building a windmill has already inspired a book, a film and a Ted Talk.
